capabilities: Compile raw notes in a raw/ folder into interlinked wiki pages
Answer questions using relevant wiki context
Backfill answers and analysis into the wiki
Run health checks for broken links, orphan pages, and gaps
Manage chat conversations and run slash-command skills
extras: README warns that LLM requests may include note content and that the API provider may log it, advising against use with sensitive notes unless the provider is trusted; /compile can consume many tokens; API keys are stored via Obsidian SecretStorage.
intentEvidence: It follows a "collect, compile, ask, backfill, improve" workflow inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
motivation: Built to follow the 'collect, compile, ask, backfill, improve' workflow inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn collected raw material into a maintained wiki or ask LLM questions grounded in vault context.

relations.evidence: The knowledge workflow is inspired by Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki idea file.
For web articles, Obsidian Web Clipper is recommended.

summary: LLM-powered plugin that compiles raw notes into an interlinked personal wiki, answers questions, backfills answers, and runs wiki health checks.
